title: Sparkly submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7c2'>
    <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='2.4'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='12' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='72' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='80' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='88' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='58' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffe9a8'>
    <path d='M14 14 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 20 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M20 60 l1.4 3.5 l3.5 1.4 l-3.5 1.4 l-1.4 3.5 l-1.4 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.4 l3.5 -1.4 z'/>
    <path d='M82 72 l1.4 3.5 l3.5 1.4 l-3.5 1.4 l-1.4 3.5 l-1.4 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.4 l3.5 -1.4 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- submarine hull -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='20' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hull stripe -->
  <rect x='22' y='55' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e0742b'/>
  <!-- belly lighter -->
  <path d='M18 60 Q50 80 82 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- conning tower -->
  <path d='M42 34 h16 a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 v8 h-24 v-8 a4 4 0 0 1 4 -4 z' fill='#e0742b'/>
  <rect x='40' y='44' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8561c'/>
  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='49' y='22' width='3' height='14' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <rect x='49' y='22' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- portholes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='5' fill='#3fd6e8' stroke='#b8561c' stroke-width='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='#3fd6e8' stroke='#b8561c' stroke-width='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='5' fill='#3fd6e8' stroke='#b8561c' stroke-width='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#c4fbff'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#c4fbff'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#c4fbff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M86 52 l10 -12 v24 z' fill='#e0742b'/>
  <path d='M86 52 l8 -8 v8 z' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <path d='M86 52 l8 8 v-8 z' fill='#b8561c'/>
  <!-- propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='52' rx='3' ry='9' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='52' rx='9' ry='3' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <g fill='#c4fbff'>
    <circle cx='16' cy='40' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='32' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='26' r='1.3'/>
  </g>
</svg>
